title: Compress to Remember: Learning Compact Memory via On-Policy Distillation for Long Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36364v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard video generators do not natively compact historical context into reusable memory tokens. As generation continues, the growing history makes it increasingly difficult to retain information from earlier frames due to long-context degradation. Key-frame-based approaches address this challenge by retaining selected past frames, but can discard information needed for future generation. Rather than relying on frame selection alone, we study whether a frozen video generator can supply the supervision needed to learn a compact representation of the history. We propose Prediction-Aligned Context Compaction (PACC), which uses a learned compressor to aggregate information across past frames into compact memory tokens. We train the compressor through on-policy distillation, using the same frozen generator both as a student when conditioned on compressed memory and as a teacher when conditioned on the full history. translated_title: 压缩以记忆：通过在线策略蒸馏学习紧凑记忆用于长视频生成
translated_abstract: 标准视频生成器无法原生地将历史上下文压缩为可复用的记忆标记。随着生成过程的持续进行，不断增长的历史内容使得由于长上下文退化，保留早期帧的信息变得越来越困难。基于关键帧的方法通过保留选定的过去帧来应对这一挑战，但可能会丢弃未来生成所需的信息。我们不单独依赖帧选择，而是研究一个冻结的视频生成器能否提供学习历史紧凑表示所需的监督信号。我们提出预测对齐上下文压缩（PACC），它使用一个学习到的压缩器将过去帧的信息聚合为紧凑的记忆标记。我们通过在线策略蒸馏来训练该压缩器，使用同一个冻结的生成器，在以压缩记忆为条件时充当学生，在以完整历史为条件时充当教师。学生生成协同……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出预测对齐上下文压缩（PACC）方法，通过在线策略蒸馏训练压缩器将历史帧聚合为紧凑记忆标记，其中同一冻结的视频生成器在完整历史条件下充当教师、在压缩记忆条件下充当学生，从而缓解长视频生成中的长上下文退化问题。
